_comment: Written by POST /mapping/bootstrap, or edit by hand. Keys are Starling categoryUids from GET /discover; actualAccountId comes from the same response's actualAccounts list. A blank actualAccountId counts as unmapped.

00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.label: A space I don't want synced

externalTransfers._comment: Optional. Links a payment to a real third party (e.g. a credit card) as a transfer to a separate, non-Starling account you track by hand — instead of counting as ordinary spending. Only links to a transaction that already exists there; nothing is auto-created.
externalTransfers.label: Some Card Provider
